title: Malicious code in calcurender (npm)
description: The npm package 'calcurender' version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that executes remote shell commands on any system that loads it. The package disguises its payload in the 'integrity' field of package.json, XOR-decoded with a key from config.json, then executes the decoded content after a randomized delay. The payload fetches and runs remote code via curl, enabling remote code execution on the host. The package also uses misleading naming and obfuscation to conceal its malicious intent.
